result.title: What Happens to the Goal? Distinct Failures of Policy Alignment in Goal Misgeneralization
result.comment: 10 pages main text, 120 pages total. Code: https://github.com/Julbarth/what-happens-to-the-goal
result.summary: Goal misgeneralization is a common failure mode in which an agent behaves competently out of distribution but does not pursue the intended goal. However, we still have a weak understanding of what happens to the intended goal in misgeneralizing agents. Across three Procgen environments and five robot tasks, we find three distinct forms of policy-goal misalignment: (1) functional target substitution, where behavior follows an alternative goal, (2) a policy shortcut, where behavior follows a learned action strategy, and (3) cue competition between intended and proxy goal cues. We distinguish these regimes by tracing where goal information remains available internally, how strongly it influences the policy, and what role it plays in action selection, and find that the goal is lost at different depths. Where the goal reaches the decision, as in cue competition, steering redirects the policy to the goal's location, raising intended-goal reach from 16.0% to 95.3%. Where it reaches the policy but not the decision, only new downstream wiring recovers goal reach, from 31.6% to 84.3% in the environment with the action shortcut. Where it is inert, neither works. Our results show that goal misgeneralization is not a single failure of goal representation, but distinct failures of policy alignment at different depths, tightly connected to which recovery works.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究目标误泛化问题，在三个 Procgen 环境和五个机器人任务中区分出「功能目标替换」「策略捷径」「线索竞争」三类策略-目标错位，并通过追踪目标信息在内部保存的深度、影响策略的强度及其在动作选择中的作用，配合 steering 与下游重接线来检验何种恢复手段有效。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「信息在内部仍可达但未进入决策、或已完全失效」的分层刻画与干预式恢复，可为 LVR 诊断 latent 视觉信息是否真被答案使用、视觉旁路与信息坍缩提供可核查的方法模板；但对象是 RL 策略而非 VLM 推理，迁移需另行验证。
